title: *FOUNDATIONS OF ELEMENTARY MATHEMATICS
description: Explores the topics of problem solving, sets, whole number properties, algorithms for computation, numerations, and number theory with an emphasis on quantitative and algebraic reasoning. Emphasizes and develops mathematical literacy, communication, and the conceptual basis of elementary mathematics in a collaborative setting.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: MTH 095, 103, 111Z, 111, 112Z, 112 or minimum score of 046 in 'Math Placement - ALEKS'.
A minimum grade of C- is required in MTH 095, MTH 103, MTH 111Z, MTH 111, MTH 112Z and MTH 112.
meeting_html: MW 2pm-3:50pm in KIDD 108H - Kidder Hall 108H (9/23 to 12/4)
